map.镜像与反转有什么区别？: What is the difference between mirror and reverse?
map.镜像按字符做左右翻转（视觉镜像），反转是改变字符顺序，两者效果不同。: Mirror flips each character left-right (visual mirror); reverse changes character order; the two effects differ.
map.逐字符查镜像字符映射表替换成对应的镜像字形，查不到时保留原字符；替换完成后把整个: Each character is looked up in a mirrored-glyph table and replaced with its mirror image, kept as-is when no match exists; then the whole result string is reversed before output to create the left-right mirrored effect; the original input is displayed separately
map.💡 「复制近似字符」使用 Unicode 近似字形并反转顺序，未收录字符会保持原: 💡 “Copy approximate characters” maps to Unicode lookalikes and reverses order; unmapped characters keep their original orientation. “Download mirrored PNG” flips real glyphs left-to-right, supports multiple lines and a transparent background — the two outputs differ.
map.将文字左右镜像：复制近似 Unicode 字符，或导出真实左右翻转、透明背景的多: Mirror text left-to-right: copy approximate Unicode characters, or export a true mirrored multi-line PNG with a transparent background. Unsupported characters are flagged; the two outputs differ.
map.复制近似 Unicode 镜像字符，或导出真正左右翻转的 PNG 图片: Copy approximate Unicode mirror characters, or export a truly mirrored PNG image
map.输入「ToolBox 工具箱」：复制结果会用 Unicode 近似字形并反转顺序: Input “ToolBox” plus Chinese text: the copied result uses Unicode lookalikes and reverses order; Chinese characters have no mapped mirror glyphs, so only their order changes. The PNG export flips the whole text with real glyphs, showing the true mirror effect.
map.复制结果依赖 Unicode 近似字形，个别平台可能因字体缺字显示异常；未收录字: The copied result relies on Unicode lookalikes; some platforms may show missing glyphs. Unmapped characters keep their original orientation. The PNG export uses system fonts and is more compatible.
map.复制结果先做近似字符映射、再反转字符顺序；PNG 导出才是把整段文字按真实字形左: The copied result first maps to lookalike characters and then reverses order; the PNG export flips the entire text with real glyphs. The outputs differ, especially for Chinese.
